# BinaryRat support

Report public BinaryRat bugs, ask usage questions or suggest features in the project’s issue tracker. [BinaryRat Issues](https://github.com/YurilLAB/BinaryRat/issues) · [Open a report](https://github.com/YurilLAB/BinaryRat/issues/new/choose)

For a bug report, include the BinaryRat commit or artifact name, Ghidra version, operating system, tool or plugin involved, and the expected and observed results. A minimal example using a disposable project helps the maintainer reproduce the problem. Keep proprietary binaries, saved investigations and credentials out of the initial report.

For deployment, licensing or a private inquiry, email **support@yurillab.dev** with “BinaryRat” in the subject. Teams that need a response deadline, a supported configuration or a commercial agreement should confirm those terms directly with YurilLAB. [YurilLAB contact page](https://yurillab.dev/#contact)

For security issues in upstream Ghidra, use its private reporting channel. [Ghidra security policy](https://github.com/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra/security/policy)
